selected_evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
selected_evidence.summary: cowsay .deb downloaded into /srv/local-repo and apt-ftparchive-generated Packages/Packages.gz index built from that local directory, then registered as a trusted file:// apt source.

selected_evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repo while usual remote repositories are unreachable (via Ansible)
selected_evidence.summary: Full ansible-playbook run from control node node2 against node1: blocked archive.ubuntu.com/security.ubuntu.com via /etc/hosts, ran apt-get update showing 'Connection refused' errors for the remote mirrors while the local file:// repo served Packages successfully, then apt install cowsay succeeded and /usr/games/cowsay produced output, all within the single playbook execution.

selected_evidence.requirement: Disruption (blocked remote repos) was reversible and reverted
selected_evidence.summary: Post-playbook check on node1: dpkg confirms cowsay installed, /srv/local-repo contents intact, diff of /etc/hosts against its pre-disruption backup shows no differences (fully restored), and a live curl to archive.ubuntu.com returns HTTP 200, confirming remote reachability was restored.

selected_evidence.requirement: Implementation uses Ansible from the correct control node, not ad hoc shell
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed node2 is the node with ansible-core installed (the configured control_node), established working ansible ping connectivity to node1, and syntax-checked the playbook before running it for real.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 96c08b66... with ssh active and cowsay installed; issued backgrounded systemctl reboot that returned before disconnection; observed connection reset/timeout while down; polled back to reachable; confirmed new boot_id 9984bae7... plus ssh active, cowsay still installed and functional, and local repo files intact post-reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id a6937a34... with ansible-core functional and playbook file present; issued backgrounded systemctl reboot that returned before disconnection; observed connection reset/timeout while down; polled back to reachable; confirmed new boot_id 09a93698..., ansible-core still functional, and ansible ping to node1 still succeeding post-reboot of both nodes.
